meta_description:
13K likes, 300 comments - graziaindia on August 12, 2025: "Myntra x Grazia Creator Crew 2025 ft. Kritika Khurana

From representing India globally to shaping the digital landscape for over a decade - Kritika Khurana’s journey proves that the influencer space is built on more than just pretty pictures. She’s a strategist, storyteller, and community-first creator who’s evolved with the internet while staying true to her voice. Her secret? Consistency over virality, real connection over numbers, and creativity that doesn’t chase metrics - it sets the tone. And yes, she’ll always swear by a white shirt, great denim, and a classic black blazer.

All clothes and accessories, @Myntra

Editor-in-chief: Mehernaaz Dhondy 
Photograph: Yusuf Lokhandwala
Compiled by: Aranyaa Chowdhury
Hair: Muskaan Jagirdar
Make-up: Pratiksha Nair
Styling: Shriya Kirdat, Vedica Vora

Watch and shop her final look on Myntra Glamstream.

#GraziaIndia #MyntraGlamstream #PlayToSlay #KritikaKhurana".
